resources.title: Handshake (USC)
resources.what: USC's job board, event RSVP and advising-booking system; expo employer lists and most info sessions live here.
resources.how: Log in with USC NetID, finish the profile, set it visible to employers, and save job alerts for analytics, product, marketing and ops internships.

resources.title: Viterbi Career Connections advising
resources.what: Viterbi career advisors: booked appointments Mon-Fri 9-5 and drop-ins Mon-Thu 1:30-3:30pm in RTH 218 (or Zoom), Aug 24-Dec 4.
resources.how: Book in Handshake (Career Center > Appointments > USC Viterbi Career Connections) or join the drop-in waitlist at https://www.waitlist.me/w/careerconnections; run the resume through Quinncia first.

resources.title: Quinncia AI resume check
resources.what: AI resume-scoring tool that Viterbi asks students to use before a drop-in resume review.
resources.how: Upload the resume here, fix the flagged items, then bring it to a Viterbi drop-in.

resources.title: USC Career Center appointments
resources.what: The university-wide Career Center (Student Union 110) also books advising through Handshake, with industry teams (Finance & Technology; Creative, Media & Management; Social Impact & Health).
resources.how: Book a session with the industry team that matches the role type, e.g. Creative, Media & Management for marketing or Finance & Technology for product/analytics.

resources.title: USC on-campus recruiting (OCR)
resources.what: Employers interview enrolled USC undergrad and grad students on campus; windows are Sep 2-Nov 20, 2026 and Jan 20-Apr 23, 2027.
resources.how: In Handshake, filter jobs by 'Interviewing on campus' and apply before each posting's deadline; late cancellations lock you out of OCR.

resources.title: USC Career Center events calendar
resources.what: Daily list of campus-wide employer info sessions (Trojan Talks), industry panels, and workshops, most with Handshake RSVP links.
resources.how: Check weekly and RSVP for sessions open to grad students; some sessions are limited by class year, so read each one's eligibility line.

resources.title: Viterbi Career Connections workshops
resources.what: Short Viterbi workshops on the U.S. job search, interviews and offer negotiation, held in RTH 211 and on Zoom.
resources.how: Attend the October sessions (job search Oct 13, interviews Oct 22, negotiation Oct 27).

resources.title: Viterbi Career & Internship Expo
resources.what: Viterbi-only career fair each fall and spring, with employer info sessions (Trojan Talks) beforehand; fall 2026 ran Sep 28-30.
resources.how: Watch for the spring 2027 date (spring 2026 was Feb 9-11) and RSVP in Handshake to see which employers are coming.

resources.title: USC Career Center career fairs
resources.what: Campus-wide General Career Fair and Internship Expo each fall and spring, open to all majors and class levels.
resources.how: Look for the spring 2027 dates in Handshake (fall 2026 fairs were Sep 9-10) and bring a printed resume.

resources.title: USC Career Fest 2027
resources.what: A week of Career Center events Jan 25-29, 2027, starting with an Employer Resume Review on Jan 25.
resources.how: Sign up for the Jan 25 Employer Resume Review and any employer sessions that week through Handshake.

resources.title: Viterbi Trek (company site visits)
resources.what: Selected Viterbi students visit one company during spring recess; first-year grad students get priority. Past hosts include McKinsey, Whatnot and The Trade Desk.
resources.how: Apply when the spring 2027 application opens (essay, then interview); needs a 3.0+ GPA. Contact joseleon@usc.edu.

resources.title: Viterbi Mock Interview Day
resources.what: One 15-minute behavioral mock interview with an industry expert or Viterbi alum; spring 2027 date not set.
resources.how: Watch Handshake email invites; registration opens early spring 2027.

resources.title: Trojan Network (PeopleGrove)
resources.what: USC's alumni mentoring and networking platform, open to grad students.
resources.how: Sign in with 'USC NetID (Students)', fill in interests, and request short chats with alumni in target companies; do not send unsolicited resumes.

resources.title: Viterbi Link (Viterbi hub on Trojan Network)
resources.what: Viterbi's own alumni and peer mentoring hub inside PeopleGrove (https://usc.peoplegrove.com/hub/viterbi/).
resources.how: Join the Viterbi hub and filter for alumni in analytics, product and marketing roles.

resources.title: LinkedIn USC alumni search
resources.what: LinkedIn's alumni tool for USC; filter by company, job title or keyword.
resources.how: Search by target company, find USC alumni in relevant roles, and ask for 15-minute informational chats.

resources.title: Big Interview
resources.what: AI mock-interview practice licensed by the Career Center.
resources.how: Log in with USC SSO and practice behavioral and role-specific interviews before first-round screens.

resources.title: Vault / Firsthand career guides
resources.what: Industry and employer guides plus 'day in the life' articles, opened through Handshake.
resources.how: Read the industry guides for consulting, marketing and tech before choosing a target industry.

resources.title: CareerShift
resources.what: Contact and job search tool for finding recruiters and hiring managers.
resources.how: Use it to find recruiter or hiring-manager contacts at target companies.

resources.title: LinkedIn Learning (free via USC)
resources.what: Online courses free to USC students, e.g. SQL, Tableau, Excel, product management.
resources.how: Take short courses to fill tool gaps listed in target job posts.

resources.title: MS Analytics program page
resources.what: Program page with core courses, tracks, and outcomes; recent grads work as data scientists, BI analysts, analytics consultants and product/marketing analysts.
resources.how: Use the outcomes list to pick target roles and employers.

resources.title: ISE 2026-2027 student handbook
resources.what: Degree rules for MS Analytics (28 units: 3 foundation, 1 project-based, 2 methodology courses, 1 elective) and the list of ISE student groups.
resources.how: Plan the spring 2027 schedule around a project-based course you can use as resume experience.

resources.title: ISE 534 Data Analytics Consulting
resources.what: Project-based MS Analytics course; the catalogue says students work on real client projects as analytics consultants.
resources.how: Consider taking it in spring 2027 to get a client project for the resume; check the Schedule of Classes for sections.

resources.title: Viterbi internship for credit (ENGR 596)
resources.what: Optional internship course for grad students; required for F-1 CPT, not for permanent residents.
resources.how: Not needed to work an internship; use only if she wants credit. Questions: engrinternshipcourses@usc.edu.

resources.title: ISE current students page
resources.what: Department resource page; it has no job board of its own and points to Viterbi and USC career services.
resources.how: Check for department notices; rely on Handshake for jobs.

resources.title: ISE Analytics Student Association (IASA)
resources.what: Club for students in the MS Analytics program, with industry events, projects and alumni networking (handbook: membership limited to Analytics students).
resources.how: Join on EngageSC and ask officers about upcoming industry or alumni events.

resources.title: INFORMS USC Student Chapter
resources.what: Grad-student chapter for operations research and analytics: talks, journal clubs, coffee hours.
resources.how: Join if operations or supply-chain analytics is a target; EngageSC shows the group as not yet registered this year, so confirm it is active.

resources.title: USC IISE (industrial & systems engineers)
resources.what: ISE professional club open to all majors, with company networking; contact usciise@gmail.com.
resources.how: Join for operations and supply-chain employer contacts.

resources.title: Engineering Management Student Association (EMSA)
resources.what: ISE club linking students with industry and alumni; free to all USC students; contact emsa@usc.edu.
resources.how: Join for industry panels and alumni contacts.

resources.title: Graduates Rising in Data Science (GRIDS)
resources.what: Viterbi graduate data-science student group (listed on the EngageSC club directory).
resources.how: Find it on EngageSC and join for data-science events.

resources.title: Advanced Degree Consulting Club (ADCC)
resources.what: Consulting-prep club for master's and PhD students.
resources.how: Join for case practice if consulting or strategy is a target.

resources.title: American Marketing Association at USC
resources.what: Marketing club open to undergrad and grad students: workshops, speakers, company tours, case competitions.
resources.how: Join for marketing and growth contacts and case competitions.

resources.title: Business Cosmetics Club
resources.what: Beauty-industry club with speaker panels and networking with industry professionals.
resources.how: Join for beauty-brand contacts that match her K-beauty background; confirm grad students can join.

resources.title: ProductSC
resources.what: USC's product-management club with intro and interview-prep programs (Compass, Catalyst).
resources.how: Email product@usc.edu to ask if grad students can join and when applications open.

resources.title: Global Supply Chain Club
resources.what: Supply-chain club with company showcases, case competitions and alumni networks (233 members).
resources.how: Join if operations or supply chain is a target; confirm grad eligibility.

resources.title: KOJOBS USC (Korean Job Search)
resources.what: Club that helps Korean undergrad and grad students build career connections with professionals; contact kojobsatusc@gmail.com.
resources.how: Join for Korean-speaking professional contacts and Korea-linked employers.

resources.title: Korean-American Scientists and Engineers Association (USC KSEA)
resources.what: STEM career club with guest speakers and a national KSEA network (listed on EngageSC; uscksea.com blocked automated access).
resources.how: Join for speaker events and the national KSEA network.

resources.title: Korean Graduate Student Association (KGSA)
resources.what: Korean graduate student group that has linked members with Korean company recruiters (per search snippet; contact usckgsa1@gmail.com).
resources.how: Email to check if the group is still active; its EngageSC page no longer loads.

resources.title: Viterbi Graduate Student Association (VGSA)
resources.what: Large Viterbi grad student association (800+ members) running academic, career and social events.
resources.how: Join and follow its event emails.

resources.title: Viterbi Graduate Mentorship Program
resources.what: Pairs new Viterbi master's students with experienced grad-student mentors; contact vgradm@vase.usc.edu.
resources.how: Ask for a mentor from MS Analytics who has done an internship search.

resources.title: Viterbi Women in Engineering graduate committee
resources.what: Grad-women programming (coffee hours, fireside chats) and a WIE newsletter; contact uscviterbiwie@gmail.com.
resources.how: Subscribe to the WIE newsletter; page is from 2020 (updated 2024), so confirm current events.

resources.title: Society of Women Engineers, USC section
resources.what: Professional-development, service and social group for women engineers at USC (listed on EngageSC; sweusc.com is down).
resources.how: Join through EngageSC for employer events.

resources.title: Analysis Group Summer Analyst 2027
resources.what: Economic-consulting summer internship open to master's students graduating winter 2027 or summer 2028, with a Los Angeles office; 3.3 GPA minimum.
resources.how: Deadline was Sep 30 but applications are still reviewed on a rolling basis; apply soon with a cover letter and transcripts.

resources.title: Capital One Current Master's Data Science Internship (Summer 2027)
resources.what: Master's-only 10-week data-science internship (quant fields incl. analytics); posted Jul 20, 2026.
resources.how: Check capitalonecareers.com; the official posting returned 404, so it may be closed.

resources.title: Rewriting the Code
resources.what: Free community for women university students in tech and data fields, with career summits, recruiter events and mentors.
resources.how: Apply (about 5 minutes) and watch for career-summit invites.

resources.title: WiDS Datathon 2027
resources.what: Kaggle data challenge for teams at least half women; 2027 details due January 2027.
resources.how: Form a team with MS Analytics classmates in January for a resume project.

resources.title: L'Oreal Brandstorm
resources.what: L'Oreal's student innovation competition for ages 18-30, open to master's students (not MBA/PhD) per third-party listings.
resources.how: Check if the U.S. is a participating country this year; site blocked automated access.

notes: Handshake needs her USC NetID. Expo employer lists, Trojan Talk RSVPs, appointment booking and most Zoom links are only visible after login.

Spring 2027 Viterbi Career & Internship Expo date is not published yet. Spring 2026 ran Feb 9-11 (fair on Feb 11), so expect early-to-mid Feb 2027; re-check https://viterbicareers.usc.edu/employers/careerexpo/ in December.

Spring 2027 USC Career Center Career Fair and Internship Expo dates are not published. Spring 2026 fairs were in early Feb (Career Fair Feb 5, 2026 per a search snippet; that page is now gone). Career Fest 2027 (Jan 25-29) is confirmed.
No USC internship-funding program for grad students was found: the Career Center Impact Scholarship ($2,500, applications Oct 12, 2026-Apr 16, 2027) is undergraduate-only.
Permanent residents and citizens do not need CPT or ENGR 596 to intern; the course is optional. Fall 2026 internship-course requests closed Oct 9.

Many Career Center info sessions limit who can attend (e.g., Flexport Oct 14 is graduating seniors only, so it is left out). Check each event's eligibility line before RSVP. No-shows can be penalized.
Viterbi drop-ins: none on Oct 8-9, Nov 6, 11, 26-27, and none Dec 7-Jan 8. Drop-ins end Dec 4.
TikTok NEXT interest form is due Oct 7, 2026 (tomorrow); TikTok confirms selected students about two days before the Oct 14 event.

LinkedIn slug 'university-of-southern-california' is confirmed by search results (official USC page, ~540K followers); LinkedIn blocks automated page loads. usc.edu also links the numeric school ID 3084. The People tab needs a logged-in LinkedIn account.
Viterbi Trek page says spring 2027 application is 'coming soon'; the employer page lists Mar 15-17, 2027. First-year grad students get priority.
IASA membership is limited to MS Analytics students (2026-27 ISE handbook), so it is the closest-fit club. EngageSC shows INFORMS USC as 'not registered yet' this year.
KGSA's EngageSC page no longer loads; KOJOBS and KSEA are the active Korean career groups found.
ProductSC, Business Cosmetics Club and Global Supply Chain Club do not state whether grad students can join; ask the officers.
The ISE department has no job board of its own (its page links to Indeed) and its events calendar did not render; Viterbi Career Connections and the Career Center are the real channels.

External programs: only items whose pages state master's eligibility are included. Forte is MBA-only and was skipped. Capital One and L'Oreal Brandstorm are verified=false (official pages did not load).

recruiting_employers mixes three signals: Viterbi partners, trek hosts and info-session hosts (they actively recruit at USC), and first-destination and MS Analytics outcome lists (where grads were hired). Source URLs show which is which.
